## Property Marketplace (App)

The agent's market-command console ("Command your market"): one hero number (value on the market), a clickable pipeline rail over the shared status ladder, the book itself (search, status filter pills, sort by newest / days-on-market / price), and a Needs-attention rail (30+ DOM listings, drafts missing photos or price). New Listing creates a draft in place.

### Composition

Consumes the Real Estate blocks UNCHANGED: PropertyListing rows from one live `getCards` query; DOM read off the card's own computed; statuses from PROPERTY_LISTING_STATUS_LABELS. Rows open with `viewCard`; nothing is patched from the app (publishing lives on the listing card).

### Identity

Dark navy + gold marketplace brand, declared once at the root as overridable knobs (`--marketplace-navy/-surface/-gold/-ink/-muted`) per boxel-theming §4a. Prerender gets a static shell (`isInteractive` gates the live panes).
